claims.statement: Commonworld's own unpaid check: an unpaid GET to https://api.402rates.com/v1/ping answered HTTP 402 with x402 v2 payment terms (scheme exact; network Arbitrum, Base, Polygon, XDC; asset USDC; price 0.001 USDC; payTo Base 0xf567Cfe0FDb87A1D6Ca330e3f30f0D3DA0F7cb98; plus 3 other network option(s)). YourAITools lists the price as $0.001–$0.03. No payment was made; a 402 shows the endpoint is up and asks for payment, not that the paid service works.
methods: unpaid GET https://api.402rates.com/v1/ping (HTTP 402, header:payment-required; no payment header sent)

claims.statement: Coinbase's x402 Bazaar (the CDP facilitator's discovery index) lists 6 resource(s) on this vendor's domain for the payTo address(es) we observed, with 84 calls in the last 30 days as reported by CDP (largest single resource: 29 unique payers; payers cannot be de-duplicated across resources). These are the facilitator's counts, not an Atlas observation of settlements.
